mapper.sql: CASE WHEN u.phonenumber IS NULL OR TRIM(u.phonenumber) = '' THEN NULL WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(u.phonenumber) >= 7 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(u.phonenumber, 3), '****', RIGHT(u.phonenumber, 4)) ELSE '***' END
mapper.select: SELECT f.id AS feedback_id, f.user_id, u.nick_name AS nickname, AS phone_masked, f.category, f.content, f.status, f.reply, f.attachment_ref AS attachment_ref, h.nick_name AS handler_name, f.create_time AS submitted_at, f.handled_at FROM user_feedback f JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = f.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user h ON h.user_id = f.handler_id WHERE f.id = #{feedbackId} LIMIT 1
SELECT f.status FROM user_feedback f WHERE f.id = #{feedbackId} LIMIT 1
SELECT f.reply FROM user_feedback f WHERE f.id = #{feedbackId} LIMIT 1
